/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in jsonschema
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("loads").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization patterns (pickle, yaml, marshal, shelve, json.loads) that could lead to code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal vulnerability
 * @description File operations with user-controlled paths can lead to path traversal attacks
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(FileSystemAccess fa).getAPathArgument()
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file operations with user-controlled paths

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure HTTP requests
 * @description Making HTTP requests with user-controlled URLs or without proper validation
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-http
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module InsecureHttpConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "options", "patch"]).getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["request", "urlopen"]).getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module InsecureHttpFlow = TaintTracking::Global<InsecureHttpConfig>;
import InsecureHttpFlow::PathGraph

from InsecureHttpFlow::PathNode source, InsecureHttpFlow::PathNode sink
where InsecureHttpFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Insecure HTTP request with user-controlled URL from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Insecure HTTP requests with user-controlled URLs
